title: Your teammate needs gift cards
scenario: A teammate messages that they forgot a parent’s birthday and cannot use their bank card. They ask you to buy a $30 gift card and send the code, promising to pay you tomorrow at practice.

answers.A: Buy it because the amount is small and you see the teammate every week.
answers.B: Verify with the teammate in person or by voice/video through a known number before buying anything.
answers.C: Offer to help them find another solution without sending a gift-card code.

explanation: Compromised accounts often ask for small, believable favors. Gift-card codes are cash once shared.
proTip: Small favor, irreversible payment: verify the person.
